dispositions.reason: Fixed, but still reported. Squisq pins every @tiptap package to 2.27.3, which backports the upstream fix: its only source change is the same __proto__ guard in mergeAttributes that 3.30.4 ships. npm still flags it because the advisory's affected range (<3.30.4) does not credit the 2.x backport.
dispositions.remediation: Nothing to renew. The verification test fails the build if an unpatched @tiptap/core is ever installed. When the advisory is corrected and npm stops reporting it, the audit gate notes that this entry can be deleted.
